activity_determination_method: Enzyme activity was evaluated by monitoring the HBC formation via gas chromatography (GC). Yields were calculated by measuring the mol of product over the mol of cyclohexene oxide loaded.
concentration_determination_method: Wet cell weight was used for whole cell concentration. For lysate, 50 g/L whole cells were pre-treated with lysozyme to obtain soluble enzyme.
formulation: Whole cell biocatalyst (E. coli BL21 expressing HheG from Ilumatobacter coccineus), also tested as soluble enzyme (cell lysate after lysozyme treatment).
special_treatment: Whole cells were harvested by centrifugation and stored at -20°C. For lysate catalysis, cells were pre-treated with lysozyme at 37°C for 1 hr. Reactions were performed in two-phase systems with 35% (v/v) ethyl acetate as co-solvent to enhance substrate solubility and avoid direct contact with pure substrate. Pilot-scale reactions used 1.2 kg wet cell in 10 L total volume. Optimal pH was maintained by hydrolysis of ethyl acetate, eliminating the need for buffer. Reaction temperature was controlled at 25°C. The process was scaled from 96-well plate (200 μL) to 50 mL, 1 L, and 10 L reactors. Isolated yield at pilot scale was 87% with ee=53%.
